name: ai-qa-testing-harness
description: Requirement-driven test suites, retesting, and regression with Playwright, GitHub Copilot, or your own AI provider

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The QA Harness runs browsers and Python test scripts.

enumDescriptions: GitHub Copilot through the VS Code Language Model API (no key)
Azure OpenAI resource endpoint + key (model = deployment name)
GitHub Models with a fine-grained token (Models: read)
No AI: smoke suites from page structure only
qaHarness.ai.provider.description: AI provider used for requirement analysis, test design, and failure investigation.

qaHarness.ai.model.description: Model ID (or Azure deployment name). Empty uses the first available Copilot model.

qaHarness.ai.baseUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint for Azure OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible providers. Empty uses the provider default.

qaHarness.ai.investigationModel.description: Optional cheaper model (or Azure deployment) used only to analyze failed tests. Empty uses the main model; if this model fails, the main model is used.

qaHarness.ai.investigateFailures.description: Analyze failed tests with AI. When off, failures are classified by deterministic rules (results are unaffected).

qaHarness.ai.maxInvestigationsPerRun.description: Max failed tests analyzed by AI per run (highest priority first). Identical errors share one analysis. Suite design is never limited.

qaHarness.ai.dailyInvestigationLimit.description: Max AI failure analyses per day in this workspace (shared by panel and CLI runs). Beyond it, failures are classified by rules.

qaHarness.ai.reuseAnalyses.description: Reuse an AI analysis from the last 7 days when the same test fails with the same error on the same approved suite and target.

qaHarness.enginePath.description: Folder containing the qa_engine package. Empty uses the workspace 'engine' folder or the copy bundled with the extension.

qaHarness.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter for the engine. Empty uses engine/.venv or the private environment created by 'Set Up Engine'.

qaHarness.headed.description: Show the browser window (headed mode) during exploration and test execution.

qaHarness.slowMoMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between browser actions in headed mode, so each step is visible.

qaHarness.browserChannel.description: Browser to drive: installed Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or empty for Playwright's bundled Chromium. Falls back to Chromium when Chrome is not installed.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle-engine && vsce package --allow-missing-repository
